## English translation

### Robin Hood announced

Posted by [saver](https://www.sector.sk/redaktor/saver.htm) on 4 February 2002 at 23:17, under games.

Fans of [Commandos](http://www.sector.sk/clanok.asp?id=2870) and [Desperados](http://www.sector.sk/clanok.asp?id=2165), rejoice: a new tactical strategy game, **Robin Hood**, is coming. It will be from the creators of *Desperados* and will take you to the Middle Ages, specifically the area of Sherwood Forest, where you will complete 40 tactical missions and play with characters such as Robin Hood, Little John, Marian, and Friar Tuck; among the enemies, you will also encounter the feared Guy of Gisbourne.

## Original text

### Robin hood ohlásený

pridal [saver](https://www.sector.sk/redaktor/saver.htm) 4.2.2002 o 23:17 pod hry

Fanúšikovia [Commandos](http://www.sector.sk/clanok.asp?id=2870) a [Desperados](http://www.sector.sk/clanok.asp?id=2165) tešte sa prichádza nové taktická stratégia **Robin Hood**. Bude od tvorcov Desperadov a zavedie vás do stredoveku konkrétne do oblasti Sherwoodskeho lesa kde prejdete 40 taktických misií a zahráte si s postavami ako Robin Hood, Málý John, Marian, Bratom Tucom a z nepriateľov stretnete aj obávaného Guy s Gisbrounu.
